title: U.S. July Nonfarm Payrolls Fall 23,000 — First Decline Since 2020; September Rate-Hike Odds Drop to 44%
summary: U.S. nonfarm payrolls fell 23,000 in July, sharply missing the +83,000 consensus estimate. A loss of 53,000 government workers drove the headline negative while private payrolls rose 30,000. CME FedWatch odds for a September Fed rate hike fell to 44%.
why: 非农数据爆冷是本周全球市场最关键驱动力：港股今日全线上涨、黄金股走强、美元回调；sell put策略者短期IV压力下行，但若本周通胀数据意外上行，降息预期可能快速逆转。

title: 港股收评：恒指涨1.05%至25937点，科指涨1.26%；黄金科网普涨，光通信跌逾6%
summary: 非农数据爆冷带动加息预期降温，港股周一全线走强。恒生指数涨1.05%报25937.49点，恒生科技指数涨1.26%，国企指数涨1.06%。联想涨超3%，京东、哔哩哔哩、阿里巴巴、小米涨超2%；黄金股紫金黄金国际涨超5%。光通信板块因FCC禁令消息逆市大跌，中际旭创跌超6%。国泰君安国际受私有化消息刺激复牌涨逾36%。
why: 港股整体风险偏好回升，科网配置机会凸显；光通信板块跌势提示FCC禁令风险仍发酵，须警惕相关标的IV异动；国泰君安国际私有化套利空间约6%。

title: S&P 500 Closes at Record 7,758; Nasdaq Gains 1.3% as Weak Jobs Data Cools Fed Hike Bets
summary: U.S. equities rallied on Friday after the surprise July jobs miss reduced Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to a record closing high of 7,758, the Nasdaq gained 1.3%, and the Dow Jones added 152 points. Trading Economics shows the index edged to 7,766 on August 10.
why: 美股续创历史新高，全球风险偏好提升；对持有美股期权（英伟达、特斯拉、迪士尼等）的sell put策略，短期IV继续压缩，但高位估值风险不可忽视，建议适当提高行权价保护。

title: China July Trade Beats Forecasts: Exports +23.9% to $397.85B, Imports +27.5%; AI Demand Sustains Edge
summary: China's July exports rose 23.9% year-on-year to $397.85 billion while imports climbed 27.5% to $285.35 billion, both exceeding estimates. The trade surplus narrowed to $112.5 billion from $125.62 billion in June. Bloomberg attributed resilience partly to a global AI infrastructure investment boom driving overseas demand for Chinese tech components.
why: 出口超预期显示中国产业链在贸易摩擦下的韧性，对港股/A股科技出口概念股构成潜在利好；顺差收窄或缓和中美/中欧贸易谈判中的贸易失衡分歧。

title: 国泰君安国际获国泰海通溢价44.2%私有化建议，今日复牌涨逾36%
summary: 国泰海通金控宣布以每股3港元、较停牌价2.08港元溢价约44.23%，通过协议安排方式私有化并撤销国泰君安国际上市地位。国泰君安国际今日复牌后大涨逾36%。当前约6%折价对应年化约12%套利收益（若私有化半年内完成）。
why: 港股大型券商整合加速，反映内地金融机构对港上市子公司估值修复的信心；私有化套利空间为期权卖方策略提供明确收益锚点参考。

title: FCC Drafts Ban on New Chinese-Made Optical Modules for U.S. Data Centers; Chinese Firms Hold 60%+ of Market
summary: The U.S. FCC is drafting rules to bar imports of new-model Chinese optical transceivers used inside AI data centers. Chinese manufacturers — led by Innolight and Eoptolink — hold over 60% of global high-bandwidth (800G+) optical module supply. The proposal is not yet final. A separate report warned the ban could cut 60% of AI data center optical supply if enacted.
why: 直接利空A股光模块龙头（中际旭创、华工科技等）及相关港股，今日港股光通信板块已跌逾6%；对美国数据中心AI基础设施构成短期供应风险；sell put策略需关注相关板块IV上升。延续报道：自8月4日彭博最初报道以来，港股光通信板块持续承压至今（8月10日）。

title: Tencent and Alibaba Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: Key Things to Watch
summary: Tencent (0700.HK) reports Q2 2026 results on August 12 after Hong Kong market close; Alibaba (9988.HK) reports August 20. Key focus areas: Tencent's AI capex trajectory (guided 'substantial H2 increase'), domestic gaming deceleration, and marketing-services growth. For Alibaba: AI cloud revenue acceleration, Qwen model commercialization, and progress ahead of its August 22 annual general meeting.
why: 腾讯明日公布Q2业绩，期权隐含波动率处于偏高位，结果公布后料回落；阿里巴巴八月下旬两大事件（财报+股东大会）叠加，为短期重要催化剂。两大龙头业绩对恒生科技指数走向有决定性影响。

title: SpaceX to Build On-Site Power Plants for Terafab Chip Factory in Texas, Advancing Joint Tesla-SpaceX Project
summary: SpaceX plans to construct natural gas-fired power plants and large battery storage arrays to supply electricity for the Terafab chip factory it is co-developing with Tesla in Grimes County, Texas. The facility will produce chips for Tesla Optimus robots, Cybercabs, and SpaceX space-based data centers. Earlier SpaceX IPO filings flagged the project could involve at least $55 billion in investment.
why: Terafab自建供电设施标志着项目实质推进加快，将Tesla/SpaceX定位从汽车+火箭升维为AI芯片+机器人综合体，潜在估值重估；但Jefferies已将Tesla 2026年EBIT预测下调37%至39亿美元，短期基本面压力仍大。持有TSLA期权的卖方需警惕事件驱动波动。

title: Disney Q3 FY2026 Beats on EPS: $2.06 vs. $1.86 Expected; Parks Revenue +10%, Streaming +11%
summary: Walt Disney reported fiscal Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.06, beating analyst estimates of $1.86. Total revenue of $25.2 billion rose 7% year-on-year. Experiences (theme parks & cruises) revenue grew 10% to $9.97 billion; entertainment streaming climbed 11% to $5.53 billion. Operating income rose 21% to $5.6 billion. Several analysts including Wells Fargo and Barclays raised price targets after the report.
why: 迪士尼主题乐园+流媒体协同效应验证，盈利质量超预期，成本控制良好；多家大行上调目标价。延续报道：8月5日业绩发布后，analyst升级持续至8月6-7日，IV已回落。对DIS期权卖方，当前Premium已收窄，继续卖出需提高行权价保护。
